findings.highlight: Though it disgusts her, she knows she's nothing like Shirou.
findings.evidenceJa: ……悔しいけれど、シロウとは違う。
findings.governingReading: 悔しい expresses bitter frustration/regret at the comparison with Shirou.

findings.highlight: There must have been someone who could have built a true utopia...
findings.evidenceJa: その人物ならば、平和な国を長く築けたのではないか—
findings.governingReading: She wonders whether another ruler could have built a peaceful country lasting a long time.
findings.explanation: Lasting peace becomes a true utopia.

findings.highlight: To deny that would be to deny everything she gave up.
findings.evidenceJa: それを否定する事は、彼女が奪った多くのモノを否定する事になる。
findings.governingReading: Denying her former kingship would deny the many things she took;9 expressly connects her course with lives lost.
findings.explanation: What she took becomes what she gave up.

findings.highlight: All that pain and regret is mine to bear. It belongs to me.
findings.evidenceJa: その痛みに耐え、悔いる事が、失われたものへの鎮魂に他ならない。
findings.governingReading: Enduring pain and regretting it constitute a requiem for what was lost.
findings.explanation: Remorse as a requiem becomes ownership of pain.

findings.highlight: "Do you not understand, fool? Shirou is more important to me."
findings.evidenceJa: 「判らぬか、下郎。そのような物より、私はシロウが欲しいと言ったのだ」
findings.governingReading: She directly says she wants Shirou rather than such an object.
findings.explanation: I want Shirou becomes Shirou is more important.

findings.highlight: I call out to her as loudly as I can between ragged breaths.
findings.evidenceJa: 乱れた呼吸を押さえて、彼女の名を口にする。
findings.governingReading: He suppresses his disordered breathing and speaks her name.
findings.explanation: Controlling breath becomes calling at maximum volume.

findings.highlight: The disappointment in his voice is palpable.
findings.evidenceJa: そう、何の感情もない声で言い捨てた。
findings.governingReading: The priest dismisses the matter in a voice without any emotion.
findings.explanation: An emotionless voice becomes palpable disappointment.

findings.highlight: To be honest, I have little interest in the Grail itself. But that is fine. If none prove worthy, I will take it, for the sake of the world itself."
findings.evidenceJa: 実を言うとなセイバー。私も、聖杯にはそう関心はないのだ。ただ、アレは私の趣味にあっている。私以外に相応しい持ち主がいないのであれば、貰い受けてやるのが世の為だろう」
findings.governingReading: He has little interest in the Grail, but it suits his personal taste/hobby.
findings.explanation: The Grail suiting his taste becomes But that is fine.

findings.highlight: I would, however, have you fulfill your duty, Overseer. Where is the vessel? Where is the heart of this war?"
findings.evidenceJa: だが、選定役として責務は果たしてもらうぞ。今回の器、魂の杯は何処にある」
findings.governingReading: The vessel is appositionally described as the cup of souls.
findings.explanation: The cup of souls becomes the heart of the war.

findings.highlight: "Correct. I was, in fact, surprised at the time as well. I had intended for Archer to remain here, but he still went out to do battle with you.
findings.evidenceJa: 「ああ、私とて驚いたのだ。アーチャーには待機を命じていたというのに、指示を破っておまえたちを襲ったのだからな。
findings.governingReading: He says he ordered Archer to remain on standby and Archer disobeyed the instruction.
findings.explanation: A violated standby order becomes a disappointed intention.

findings.highlight: She must also want clarity about what she left behind ten years ago and the disaster that followed.
findings.evidenceJa: 十年前の惨事の罪を問うように。
findings.governingReading: The narration likens her questions to demanding an account of guilt for the disaster ten years ago.
findings.explanation: Calling catastrophe guilt to account becomes seeking clarity about her own past.

findings.highlight: Such equivalent exchange can be found all over the world. A miracle would require a means by which to make itself possible.
findings.evidenceJa: この世は全て等価交換によって成り立っている。その中で特出した出来事を望むのならば、何かを食いつぶして飛び上がるしかあるまい。
findings.governingReading: He says the whole world is founded on equivalent exchange and exceptional achievement requires consuming something to rise.
findings.explanation: A world founded on exchange and consuming something becomes examples and a generic means.

findings.evidenceJa: 心からの感謝を表す、邪気のない聖者の笑み。
findings.governingReading: The expression communicates heartfelt gratitude and an innocent saintly smile.
findings.explanation: An innocent saint’s grateful smile becomes pure delight.

findings.highlight: We've got no attachments to this world. Heroes really only care about promises left unfulfilled.
findings.evidenceJa: オレたちはこの世に固執してるんじゃない。果たせなかった未練に固執するのみだ。
findings.governingReading: Heroes cling to unresolved regrets/attachments or things left unfulfilled, rather than this world.

findings.highlight: "Lancer, he possesses the originals of Noble Phantasms. He is the King of Heroes, the man whose story is the oldest ever recorded. Even you cannot defeat him..."
findings.evidenceJa: 「……ランサー。アレはあらゆる宝具の原型を持つ者、我らの中で最も古い歴史を持つ英雄王です。いくら貴方でも一対一では—」
findings.governingReading: Saber calls him the Hero King with the oldest history among them.
findings.explanation: Oldest among us becomes oldest ever recorded.

findings.highlight: "Damn. A guy who'd destroy his own country to do whatever the hell he wanted... No wonder he's so full of it."
findings.evidenceJa: 「……チッ、そうかよ。なるほど、どうりで偉そうなワケだ。やりたい放題やって国を滅ぼしたって野郎だからな、そりゃ性根が腐ってる」
findings.governingReading: Lancer insults him as a man who did as he pleased and destroyed his country.
findings.explanation: Ruining the country through indulgence becomes ruining it to enable indulgence.

findings.highlight: "Then farewell. I will return the favor if I can."
findings.governingReading: She wishes him fortune in battle and promises this debt will certainly be repaid.
findings.explanation: A firm repayment pledge becomes if I can.

findings.highlight: The pain, on the other hand, doesn't much care how slowly we're moving, as it doesn't dull in the slightest.
findings.evidenceJa: ゆっくりと地上へ上がっていく俺たちを余所に、地下の両者は対峙を止めなかった。
findings.governingReading: As they slowly climb to the surface, the two opponents below continue facing each other.
findings.explanation: The opponents maintaining their standoff becomes Shirou’s undiminished pain.
